key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon densities of states while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond spectral predictions enable high-throughput screening for electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic materials properties.
method: Decode spectra from crystal structures using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra through learned continuity-equation transport.
Recover element-resolved spectral contributions without supervision.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports best accuracy across all evaluated eDOS and phDOS metrics, plus new DFT validation on 8,106 uncharted materials confirming VB gaps in 25 of the model’s top 50 candidates.
watch_item: Physical constraints do not guarantee accurate spectra for every material; high-priority candidates still warrant DFT or experimental validation.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
